name: agy-safe-setup
description: Least-privilege, bounded-autonomy, and recoverable safety plugin for Google Antigravity (AGY).

author.name: QianQIUlp and Antigravity Safe Setup Contributors

interface.longDescription: Audits the real filesystem, credential-read, network, approval, and recovery boundaries of local Antigravity (CLI, IDE, 2.0 Desktop); then installs a consent-driven least-privilege profile with deterministic lifecycle hooks, reversible configuration, and optional Git checkpoints.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Antigravity permissions and install the recommended safe profile.
Explain what my current Antigravity setup can read, change, and send.
Verify my Antigravity safety configuration, lifecycle hooks, and checkpoint recovery.
